versions.changelog:
Initial release of Expense Tracker Pro.

- Log expenses using natural language (e.g., "Spent $23.50 on lunch").
- Automatic categorization of spending.
- Track expenses against custom budgets.
- Get on-demand spending summaries and detailed reports.
- Persistent data storage with SkillBoss KV.
- Includes triggers like "log expense," "budget check," and "expense report."
